name: Baked Air Fryer Apples
desc: Honeycrisp apple halves filled with buttery oats, brown sugar and walnuts and air fried until tender.

source.title: Baked Air Fryer Apples
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: Vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, for serving

steps: Cut the apples in half from stem to bottom. With a paring knife, spoon or melon baller, remove the core, stem and some of the flesh to make a hollow.
In a bowl, stir the butter, oats, brown sugar, walnuts, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt until combined.
Divide the filling among the apple halves.
Set the halves in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry at 350°F for 20-25 min, until a fork slides into the apple easily and the topping is toasted. (Oven: 375°F, about 40 min.)
Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.
tips: Granny Smith or Fuji also work. Do not cut the apples too far ahead or they brown; the filling can be mixed ahead and refrigerated.
Reheat leftovers in the air fryer at 370°F for 3-4 min.

references.title: Baked Air Fryer Apples
